text: The human tag-event landing moved tag creation and update coverage into test_ext_messages_tags.js and removed it from the larger test_ext_messages.js file. The fixed accepted xpcshell.toml registers the dedicated feature test. Use this existing test_ext_messages_<feature>.js family for related tag coverage and preserve the registration when splitting a test. This is a scoped file and test naming recommendation; the historical registration was .ini, and no repository-wide migration rule or runtime result is inferred. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.
title: Keep tag API tests in the named feature test and its actual manifest
